agent_counters.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,SUM(total_tasks) total_tasks,SUM(completed_tasks) completed_tasks,SUM(failed_tasks) failed_tasks,SUM(total_token_usage) tokens,SUM(total_execution_time_ms) execution_ms FROM agents GROUP BY 1

worker_usage_7d.sql: SELECT role,runtime,status,COUNT(*) n,SUM(json_type(metadata,'$.runtime_usage.total_tokens') IN ('integer','real')) measured_token_rows,SUM(json_extract(metadata,'$.runtime_usage.total_tokens')) reported_tokens,SUM(json_type(metadata,'$.runtime_usage')='object') usage_objects FROM worker_leases WHERE julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1,2,3

loop_status_7d.sql: SELECT loop_name,status,COUNT(*) n FROM loop_runs WHERE julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1,2

closure_coverage.sql: SELECT l.loop_name,l.status,COUNT(*) runs,SUM(c.loop_run_id IS NOT NULL) closures,SUM(julianday(l.created_at)>=julianday(?)) runs7d,SUM(c.loop_run_id IS NOT NULL AND julianday(l.created_at)>=julianday(?)) closures7d FROM loop_runs l LEFT JOIN loop_learning_closures c ON c.loop_run_id=l.id GROUP BY 1,2

closure_records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,SUM(previous_score IS NULL) baseline_only,SUM(score_delta>0) positive_delta,SUM(score_delta<0) negative_delta,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM loop_learning_closures

closure_reasons_7d.sql: SELECT reason.value reason,COUNT(*) events,COUNT(DISTINCT loop_run_id) runs,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM loop_events JOIN json_each(metadata,'$.blocked_reasons') reason WHERE event_type='learning_closure_blocked' AND julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC

learning_event_counts_7d.sql: SELECT event_type,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT loop_run_id) runs,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM loop_events WHERE (event_type LIKE '%learning%' OR event_type LIKE '%effort%' OR event_type LIKE '%evolve%') AND julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1

learning_cycles_7d.sql: SELECT json_extract(result_json,'$.producer') producer,COUNT(*) cycles,SUM(json_extract(result_json,'$.episodesIngested')) episodes,SUM(json_extract(result_json,'$.reflectionsGenerated')) reflections,SUM(json_extract(result_json,'$.proposalsGenerated')) proposals,SUM(json_extract(result_json,'$.goalsGenerated')) goals,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM learning_cycles WHERE julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1

swarm_learning.sql: SELECT category,COUNT(*) n,SUM(times_applied) reported_times_applied,MIN(created_at) first_at,MAX(updated_at) last_at FROM swarm_learning GROUP BY 1

swarm_sessions_states.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,MAX(created_at) last_created_at FROM swarm_sessions GROUP BY 1

swarm_missions_states.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,MAX(created_at) last_created_at FROM swarm_missions GROUP BY 1

swarm_tasks_states.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,MAX(created_at) last_created_at FROM swarm_tasks GROUP BY 1

swarm_capabilities_states.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,MAX(created_at) last_created_at FROM swarm_capabilities GROUP BY 1

memory_candidates_states.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,MAX(created_at) last_created_at FROM memory_candidates GROUP BY 1

maker_genomes_states.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,MAX(created_at) last_created_at FROM maker_genomes GROUP BY 1

outcome_assessments.sql: SELECT status,signal_status,causal_support,COUNT(*) n,MAX(replications) max_replications,MAX(updated_at) last_at FROM outcome_learning_assessments GROUP BY 1,2,3

skill_identity_7d.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN skill_id LIKE 'loop-maker:gym:%' OR skill_id LIKE 'gym:%' THEN 'gym' WHEN skill_id LIKE 'loop-maker:merge:%' THEN 'merge_survival' WHEN skill_id LIKE 'loop-maker:%' THEN 'production_maker' WHEN skill_id LIKE 'agent:%' THEN 'agent_reported' ELSE 'other' END kind,COUNT(*) n,SUM(success) successes,SUM(task_id IS NOT NULL AND task_id<>'') task_ids,SUM(skill_version IS NOT NULL AND skill_version<>'') versions,SUM(skill_content_hash IS NOT NULL AND skill_content_hash<>'') hashes,SUM(model IS NOT NULL AND model<>'') models,SUM(tokens_used) tokens FROM skill_outcomes WHERE julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1

power_7d.sql: SELECT host,COUNT(*) samples,MIN(at) first_at,MAX(at) last_at,ROUND(AVG(gpu_watts),2) mean_gpu_watts FROM host_power_samples WHERE julianday(at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1

model_calls_7d.sql: SELECT consumer,COUNT(*) n,SUM(tokens_in IS NOT NULL AND tokens_out IS NOT NULL) complete_token_rows,SUM(COALESCE(tokens_in,0)+COALESCE(tokens_out,0)) reported_tokens,SUM(list_price_cost IS NOT NULL) priced_rows FROM llm_model_calls WHERE julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

genome_trials.sql: SELECT state,COUNT(*) n,MAX(recorded_at) last_at FROM genome_trial_results GROUP BY 1

swarm_lineage.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,SUM(goal_id IS NOT NULL) goal_links,SUM(panel_id IS NOT NULL) panel_links FROM swarm_missions

judgment_modes_7d.sql: SELECT judgment,mode,decision,COUNT(*) n FROM judgments WHERE judgment IN ('value_allocation','effort_decision','knowledge_gap') AND julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1,2,3

recent_curve_cohort.sql: SELECT id,loop_name,status,created_at,json_extract(metadata,'$.retry_count') retry_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM worker_leases w WHERE w.loop_run_id=l.id) leases,(SELECT SUM(json_extract(w.metadata,'$.runtime_usage.total_tokens')) FROM worker_leases w WHERE w.loop_run_id=l.id) measured_lease_tokens FROM loop_runs l ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

weeks.per_kwh_reason: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: metered hosts sampled 78.1 % of the week (< 80 %)
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: metered hosts sampled 30.0 % of the week (< 80 %)

notes: Energy is GPU package power from the host agent (rocm-smi / nvidia-smi), integrated per job window; windows without samples are not measured.
Overlapping jobs on one host share the measured Wh equally while they overlap; idle host power is attributed to nobody (hosts[].gpu_kwh is the wall-meter figure).
per kWh counts only changes made on a metered host, and only when the metered hosts were sampled for ≥ 80 % of the week.
Value v1 credits only maker species (verified production runs); reviewers, models, memory and knowledge are credited in E2.

notes: SHADOW: proposals are never applied; class and proposal come from the 7-day window; the 30-day window decides raise/keep when the 7-day one is INSUFFICIENT / UNKNOWN_COST and the 30-day one is VALUE_PROVEN (the reason names the window).

Peer medians (value per M cloud tokens) compare like with like: makers with makers, judgments with judgments. Proven value at 0 known cloud tokens is raise_share (dominates on value per cloud token); unknown energy is reported as unknown, never 0.
NULL token counts are unknown, never 0; energy without ≥ 90 % sampled job time is unknown (null).

value units = verified × 1 + survived on main × 3 (outcome_credits; merge outcomes settled in the window, credited to the run's maker lease and credited judgments/reviewers; fitness-view weights). NO_CONSUMER = 0 by design, not unknown.
